title: Best Books/Courses/Channels to Leapfrog on AI/ML Material
author: lobsters_ai
summary_raw: <p>Assuming I have been on hibernation since 2018-19 time frame, which materials - books, MOOC courses and YT channels would be recommended for me to get started with understanding all the current progress on AI/ML. Ideally a resource like <a href="https://teachyourselfcs.com/" rel="ugc">TeachYourselfCS</a> that can give structure and roadmap to navigate all the progress/knowledge on the domain would really help.</p> <p>Do we have to take different approaches to understand LLMs vs other type of ML models which have been in large scale deployment/usage from pre-2022/21 time frame?</p> <p>Thanks a lot in advance.</p>
